usedFor: Urable holds detailing jobs and customers, and Google Docs keeps a written log through “Add or Replace Text In Tab”.

bestTemplate.name: “When a job is completed” in Urable, then “Add or Replace Text In Tab” in Google Docs
bestTemplate.why: Each completed job adds a line to a tab, giving a shareable history of finished work.

watchOut: “When job gets paid” in Urable is polling, so the entry appears after a scheduled check.
